title: Release anchor timeline and pin decision log
content:
Context:
- Personal scratch notes for the upcoming model flip tied to release v2026.03. Objective is to anchor a small cohort, validate stability and quality signals for 72 hours, then decide whether to pin for broader rollout.
- This is not the official runbook; distilled thoughts and decision heuristics I will use during the window.

High-level plan (timeline):
- Day 0 (prep, T-48h): warm caches on shadow traffic, run smoke suite, validate canary dataset responses. Confirm infra capacity and fallback routes.
- Day 1 (T-24h to T+0): roll canary to 0.5% traffic for 3 hours, monitor hard signals. If green, bump to 2% for next 6 hours.
- Day 2 (T+24h): steady 5% for 24 hours, run targeted evals on PRS prompts and hallucination prompt set.
- Decision point (T+48-72h): decide pin/unpin or staged expansion. Pin if signals within thresholds and no regression in quality.

Canary cohorts and routing notes:
- Cohort A (internal beta): 100% of synthetic tests + 100 internal users (ticket-based). Low latency target 95th < 300ms.
- Cohort B (external micro cohort): 5% of user bucket X (non-paying, EU region first). Check for region-specific regressions.
- Route rule: prefer dedicated pool if under 70% utilization, else fall back to hosted variant with same model family.

Metrics and thresholds (primary):
- Error rate (5xx + model exceptions): threshold 0.4% absolute increase over baseline for >15m => amber, >1% => red.
- Latency p95: absolute increase > +80ms over baseline persistent for 15m => amber, > +200ms => red.
- Token cost delta: if per-token cost increases by >12% without clear quality improvement => flag for product discussion.
- Quality regressions: Responsible evals below threshold: F1 or BLEU drop >3 points on regression set OR hallucination rate increase >2x baseline => immediate rollback candidate.
- User-facing complaints: >3 distinct high-severity tickets mentioning hallucinations or broken completions in 1 hour => escalate.

Observability checklist (what I will have open):
- Per-route latency traces (console: /routes/canary-model)
- Token-level billing breakdown (console: billing tokens by model)
- Regression dashboards (hosted-api/regressions/last-7d)
- Live eval runner outputs (linked artifact INF-4372)
- Slack watch channel: #canary-watch (page on red canary alerts)

Manual steps for pinning (quick):
- Validate canary metrics snapshot and export to artifact (screenshot + CSV).
- Create a PR to update route pin (runtime config) with approval from SRE and PM. PR template: include metrics, snapshot, linked evals.
- Coordinate 30-min quiet window for pinning with on-call and SRE.
- Post-pin: raise traffic to 25% over 2 hours, monitor 15-minute slices for anomalies.

Rollback and escape hatches:
- Immediate rollback: run route rollback via console to previous model hash and notify #canary-watch. Have automatic fallback policy enabled (auto-fallback to model-variant-stable).
- Rapid mitigation: reduce concurrency per-instance, throttle new sessions, enable cheaper quantized fallback for lower-priority traffic.
- Postmortem triggers: any red signal event that required rollback or user-visible outage -> full postmortem template within 72 hours.

Open questions and TODOs (notes to self):
- Do we have an up-to-date hallucination test set that reflects recent prompts? Action: ask research to refresh (Priya).
- Confirm whether EU cohort needs data residency checkbox for private deployments. Action: Ping legal/compliance.
- Need a quick script to diff token-cost snapshots pre/post pin (so I don't eyeball numbers). Action: Liam to prototype.
- Should we include canary-specific feature flags for function-calling behavior? Might reduce blast radius.

Quick decision heuristics (for phone-in decisions):
- If latency amber but errors and quality green: hold and observe; do not rollback unless sustained 6+ hours.
- If hallucination regression OR user-seen incorrect outputs >= threshold: rollback immediately.
- If billing/cost delta spikes but quality improved materially (customer-facing metrics): escalate to PM for pricing/communication, can consider temporary cap on traffic.

Communications plan:
- For any amber alert: post summary to #canary-watch with metric snapshot and recent traces.
- For rollback: immediate message with link to rollback commit, incident token, and initial cause hypothesis.
- For pin: short announcement in #deployments with links to artifacts and decision rationale.

Slack + ticket references to attach to final runbook:
- Linear INF-4372 (canary evals)
- GitHub runtime PR 892 (hotfix branch)
- Slack thread: pinned in #canary-watch titled "v2026.03 canary thread"
